_comment: Wave D-1 (#155): Octavia's consignment day-trade stall (RELOCATION-FLAGGED -- a Celum day-tripper through the Door, non-citizen trader, NOT resident). Voice: fast-talking sales pitch, low-20s nerves, the stink/explosion gag (2.44) referenced ONCE. SHE teaches [Mixer]: the 'Show me' option is HIDDEN until the player buys anything from her (bought_from_octavia), runs a warmth beat (the 'lesson' node), then banks the FIRST synthesized_draught (mixer's gained_by). 'Apprentice of Saliss' NEVER appears. hide_when synthesized_draught retires the lesson once the player is already mixing.

hub.speaker: Octavia
hub.text: You look like someone who could use a potion. Everyone can use a potion. Mine are very reasonably priced and only occasionally on fire — once. The scorch is still on the counter. Solvent or salts, six gold either way. What do you need?

text_variants.text: Back already. Told you it gets in the blood. What are we mixing today?
A paying customer, my favorite kind. Anything else, or do you want to see how these actually get made?

options.text: A twist of mineral salts. (6 gold)
Show me how you make these.

bought.speaker: Octavia
bought.text: Corked and honest. Do not drink the solvent straight — one person did that once and I am still not allowed back in that inn. I mean it about the solvent.

lesson.speaker: Octavia
lesson.text: Okay. Real talk, because you actually bought something and that buys you the good lesson. Measure everything before it touches the flame. It will hiss at you. When it does, keep your hands level and keep pouring. Here, take the bench — cheap reagents, low flame. Watch my hands, then do exactly what I did, step by step.

first_mix.speaker: Octavia
first_mix.text: And it holds. Look at that. First try, no fire. Nobody crying, either. You have the knack, which is more than I can say for half of Celum. Keep at it — mix enough of these and one night you wake up with a class. Xif keeps his benches right there. Go make a mess of your own.
